_what: The one speed scale every voice and every player reads (parts/ui/show/speed-control, src/voices.mjs): a speed is how many times faster than natural a sound plays, with the pitch kept (1 is natural). `presets` are the steps offered as one press; anything from `min` to `max` in `step`s is set with the slider, which moves on a log scale so 0.1 to 1 gets as much room as 1 to 16. `default` is the speed of a voice or place nobody set. A player that cannot reach a speed plays the nearest one it can.
